sources.title: qwen3-14b · Alibaba Cloud · Qwen | HotON.ai
sources.snippet: qwen3-14b is a Text model from Alibaba Cloud · Qwen (CN). HotON.ai tracks it at $0.06 per 1M input tokens and $0.24 per 1M output tokens, with a 41K-token context window.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the integration of thinking mode (for complex, multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode (for rapid, context-driven responses) into a unified framework.

sources.title: Qwen 3 14B — CanIRun.ai
sources.snippet: The flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro.

sources.title: Qwen3 14B — Specs, VRAM & How to Run Locally | Convly AI
sources.snippet: A mid-size dense Qwen3 (Apache 2.0, 128K context) that hits a sweet spot for local use — runs 4-bit on a 12GB card while staying genuinely capable.
